grain_rationale: dataset.row_count is 13014 and dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, so the source carries no exact duplicate rows; airport_code has distinct_count 3 and observed_hour_utc has distinct_count 4341, and 3*4341=13023 is close to but not exactly row_count 13014, indicating the composite of airport and observed hour is the natural near-unique grain with a small number of missing airport-hour combinations rather than duplication, so a derived identity over (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) is used to key one row per observed weather reading per airport per hour.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: The three-letter airport code (distinct_values EWR, JFK, LGA; null_rate 0.0) identifying which NYC-area airport the weather reading belongs to.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: The UTC timestamp of the weather observation (min 2013-01-01T06:00:00, max 2013-07-01T03:00:00, distinct_count 4341, null_rate 0.0) that times each event, sampled at hourly resolution.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: The local calendar date of the observation (distinct_count 181, range 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30, null_rate 0.0), a label derived from local time rather than the event timestamp.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: The local hour of day as an integer 0-23 (distinct_count 24, null_rate 0.0), a categorical time-of-day label rather than a measured quantity.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: The air temperature in Fahrenheit (range 10.94 to 93.92, distinct_count 130, null_rate 0.0), a continuous measured quantity compared across readings.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: The dewpoint temperature in Fahrenheit (range -9.94 to 73.94, distinct_count 119, null_rate 0.0), a measured atmospheric quantity.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: The relative humidity percentage (range 12.74 to 100.0, distinct_count 2178, null_rate 0.0), a measured quantity compared across hourly readings.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: The wind direction in compass degrees (range 0 to 360, distinct_count 37), nullable with null_rate 0.016828, likely reflecting calm-wind readings where direction is undefined.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: The wind speed in mph (range 0.0 to 1048.36058, distinct_count 36), nullable with a very low null_rate of 0.000154 indicating occasional missing sensor readings.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: The wind gust speed in mph (range 16.11092 to 62.14212, distinct_count 35), heavily nullable with null_rate 0.745505 since gusts are only recorded when they occur.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: The precipitation amount in inches (range 0.0 to 1.06, distinct_count 50, null_rate 0.0), a measured and summable quantity.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: The barometric pressure in millibars (range 983.8 to 1038.4, distinct_count 430), nullable with null_rate 0.114953 reflecting missing station readings.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: The visibility distance in miles (distinct_values ranging 0.0 to 10.0, distinct_count 20, null_rate 0.0), a measured quantity compared across readings.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: The full airport name (distinct_values John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport; null_rate 0.0), a descriptive label for airport_code.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: The municipality where the airport is located (distinct_values New York, Newark; null_rate 0.0), a categorical attribute of the airport.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: The airport's elevation in feet (distinct_values 13, 18, 21; null_rate 0.0), a fixed numeric label of the airport rather than a measured event quantity.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: The airport's longest runway length in feet (distinct_values 7002, 11000, 14511; null_rate 0.0), a fixed numeric label of the airport rather than a measured quantity.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: A capture timestamp with only 3 distinct values across the dataset (2026-09-02T23:26:11 to 2026-09-02T23:26:13, null_rate 0.0), reflecting batch ingestion rather than the business event time, so it is not the time field.

category_description: Each row is one hourly weather observation recorded at a specific NYC-area airport (JFK, LGA, or EWR), capturing temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, and visibility readings for a given UTC hour.
purpose: This mapping declares how the contracted silver.silver_airport_weather table enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category, including its grain, time column, and field roles, for consumption by the deterministic modeling engine that generates the gold models.
usage: The mapping is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema and datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before the modeling engine builds any gold model from it; it is never executed directly.
limitations: The mapping does not reconcile the small gap between the 13023 airport-hour combinations implied by 3 distinct airport_code values times 4341 distinct observed_hour_utc values and the actual row_count of 13014, leaving investigation of any missing hourly readings to consumers; it also leaves interpretation of wind_gust_mph's high null_rate (0.745505) and any circular treatment of wind_dir_degrees to downstream analysis, and it proposes no quality rules, transformations, or filters beyond the stated row identity.
